rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=11, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=4.5, img_sy=4.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-18: ONE knob changed vs the iter-17 WIN base (image-domain bilateral WINDOW SIZE img_kernel 9->11); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_17.json (img_sx/img_sy=4.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, proj_sr=0.02, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-17 SSIM 0.8368 / hr 0.3251 / PSNR 20.08). THE PRE-REGISTERED iter-18 STEP: WIDEN THE WINDOW that the re-liberated sigma now requests. Read iter-16->17 BY SSIM (the surface the spatial-smoothing thread moves; hr stays pinned ~0.325-0.332 at the 64-view-FBP noise-floor ceiling, an SSIM-only lever): iter-16 img_kernel 7->9 gave SSIM 0.8246->0.8284 (+0.0038, kernel thread saturating at the then-sigma=3.5); iter-17 RE-LIBERATED the sigma img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5 at kernel=9 and LIFTED SSIM 0.8284->0.8368 (+0.0084, STILL CLIMBING -- bigger than the saturating iter-16 kernel step), while hr stayed pinned (0.3283->0.3251) and PSNR flat (20.12->20.08). So sigma re-liberation is the live thread and it is NOT yet saturated. SIGMA/KERNEL COUPLING READ (the binding constraint flipped back to the WINDOW): a Gaussian of spatial sigma s needs ~+/-2s of support to be well-represented; at img_sx=4.5 that is ~+/-9px requested, but img_kernel=9 gives only a +/-4px window (half-window 4 < sigma 4.5). So the sigma=4.5 Gaussian is AGAIN truncated by the window -- the +0.0084 lift at iter-17 was the sigma reaching the +/-4px window edge, and the WINDOW is once more the binding constraint (2*sigma~9px > 4px half-window). FAILURE MODE this iter addresses: at kernel=9 the img_sx=4.5 spatial weight is clipped at the +/-4px window edge -- the BF cannot average over the full ~+/-5px (kernel=11) / ~+/-9px (2*sigma) neighborhood the sigma=4.5 requests. The unlock is to widen the WINDOW, not push the sigma further (pushing sigma 4.5->5.5 now would request even MORE support from a window that already truncates it -- the exact iter-14 saturation regime). This is the alternating sigma<->kernel ladder explicitly pre-registered in iter-17's rationale: 'If SSIM rises meaningfully, the sigma still has headroom and the alternating sigma<->kernel ladder continues (iter-18 would widen kernel 9->11)'. SSIM rose +0.0084 (meaningfully), so the ladder continues to the kernel. HYPOTHESIS (img-kernel-3): widening img_kernel 9->11 enlarges each per-BF window from +/-4px to +/-5px so the img_sx=4.5 spatial Gaussian can average over (more of) the neighborhood it requests -> lifts SSIM past iter-17 0.8368 on the SAME seed=42 split. Expect hr to stay pinned ~0.325-0.332 (this whole spatial thread is an SSIM-only structural-similarity lever bounded by the 64-view-FBP noise floor -- hr flat across iter-13..17). DIAGNOSTIC: if SSIM rises meaningfully (gain >0.005) the climb continues and iter-19 would RE-LIBERATE the sigma again (4.5->5.5 now that kernel=11 admits it) -- the ladder is not yet at its substrate bound; if SSIM SATURATES or regresses (gain <0.005) the image-domain spatial denoising is exhausted at the ~0.84 SSIM / ~0.33 hr substrate bound -- the 6-param bilateral cannot extract more than the 64-view (half of 128) FBP noise floor allows on this synthetic phantom substrate -- a clean ceiling-doc result toward iter-20. Chose img_kernel 9->11 (the EXPLICITLY pre-registered iter-18 next step -- continue the alternating ladder by raising the binding constraint, which is now the WINDOW since 2*sigma=9px > the kernel=9 +/-4px half-window) over (a) pushing img_sx/img_sy 4.5->5.5 NOW (the sigma is window-truncated at kernel=9, so widening it further requests support the +/-4px window cannot deliver -- the iter-14 saturation regime; widen the window FIRST, re-liberate sigma at iter-19 if the kernel saturates), (b) proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf (whole proj domain confirmed flat at iter-11/12 -- symmetry trap, wasted), (c) img_sr (exhausted + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction -- tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- FORBIDDEN, stays LOOSE 0.02), (d) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs/seed/val_n (all DEAD FLAT / variance-only, exhausted), (e) grad_clip (mandatory overflow guard at 1.0, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-17 values: img_sx=4.5/img_sy=4.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sr=0.02, proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-16/17 ran ~762-764 s at img_kernel=9; an 11-px image-BF window is modestly slower per step than a 9-px window (the image-domain conv is a small fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj per-step cost) -- n_iter=400/val_n=6 kept at iter-17 values, so wall stays comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized; do NOT tighten img_sr.
